<script>
(() => {
  const atlasUrl = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/unitystation/unitystation/refs/heads/develop/UnityProject/Assets/Resources/Icons/GenEmoji_Atlas.png";
  document.querySelectorAll('.emoji-preview').forEach((node) => {
    const x = Number(node.dataset.x || 0);
    const y = Number(node.dataset.y || 0);
    const w = Number(node.dataset.w || 0);
    const h = Number(node.dataset.h || 0);
    node.style.backgroundImage = `url('${atlasUrl}')`; 
    node.style.backgroundPosition = `${-x}px ${-y}px`; 
    node.style.width = `${w}px`; 
    node.style.height = `${h}px`; 
    node.style.backgroundSize = 'auto'; 
  });
})();
</script>
